title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.0 Release Candidate 4
summary: Version 1.0.0 Release Candidate 4 fixes the Keyboard Shortcuts layout so the supported controls remain evenly spaced when the Settings window or Windows display scaling changes.
changes: Arranges the remaining supported shortcut controls as four clear, evenly spaced rows.
Reflows the rows when the shortcut panel changes height instead of leaving every control bunched at its top edge.
Centers the layout at large window sizes and caps row spacing so maximized windows remain readable.
Uses the controls' actual scaled sizes, keeping labels, choices, and dropdowns aligned at different Windows display scaling levels.
Preserves the RC3 shortcut behavior, saved selections, and disabled defaults for newly created preferences.
testing: Open Other Options at the normal Settings size and confirm the four shortcut rows are evenly distributed through the Keyboard Shortcuts panel.
Resize and maximize Settings and confirm the shortcut controls remain centered, separated, and aligned.
Check the layout at the Windows display scaling levels available on the test computers.
Set shortcut choices, restart MWB, and confirm those selections still persist and work.
Start RC4 in a fresh folder and confirm every shortcut defaults to disabled.
Open About and confirm the displayed product version is 1.0.0-rc.4.
Run the same RC4 EXE on both computers and briefly recheck mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, and reconnect behavior.
